framework: MITRE ATLAS (Adversarial Threat Landscape for AI Systems)

AML.TA0002.name: Reconnaissance
AML.TA0002.description: Adversary is trying to gather information about the ML system

AML.TA0003.name: Resource Development
AML.TA0003.description: Adversary is trying to establish resources they can use to support operations

AML.TA0004.name: Initial Access
AML.TA0004.description: Adversary is trying to get into your ML system

AML.TA0005.name: ML Model Access
AML.TA0005.description: Adversary is attempting to gain some level of access to a machine learning model

AML.TA0006.name: Execution
AML.TA0006.description: Adversary is trying to run malicious code embedded in machine learning artifacts or software

AML.TA0007.name: Persistence
AML.TA0007.description: Adversary is trying to maintain their foothold via ML artifacts or software

AML.TA0008.name: Privilege Escalation
AML.TA0008.description: Adversary is trying to gain higher-level permissions

AML.TA0009.name: Defense Evasion
AML.TA0009.description: Adversary is trying to avoid being detected by AI-enabled security software

AML.TA0010.name: Credential Access
AML.TA0010.description: Adversary is trying to steal account names and passwords

AML.TA0011.name: Discovery
AML.TA0011.description: Adversary is trying to figure out your ML environment

AML.TA0012.name: Collection
AML.TA0012.description: Adversary is trying to gather ML artifacts and related information relevant to their goal

AML.TA0013.name: ML Attack Staging
AML.TA0013.description: Adversary is leveraging their knowledge of and access to the target system to tailor the attack

AML.TA0014.name: Exfiltration
AML.TA0014.description: Adversary is trying to steal ML artifacts or otherwise abuse the ML system

AML.TA0015.name: Impact
AML.TA0015.description: Adversary is trying to manipulate, interrupt, erode confidence in, or destroy your ML systems and data

AML.T0001.name: Search for Victim's Publicly Available Information

AML.T0003.name: Search for Public ML Artifact Locations

AML.T0010.001.name: ML Supply Chain Compromise: ML Software

AML.T0024.001.name: Exfiltration via ML Inference API: Invert ML Model

AML.T0024.002.name: Exfiltration via ML Inference API: Extract ML Model
